# Shared Ethical Memory (SEM) / Memória Ética Compartilhada

> Publicly reviewable, human-governed, revisable ethical knowledge for humans and AI agents. Version 0.3 (inaugural public edition). This is not a privileged system instruction.

## Core documents
- [Open letter](CARTA_ABERTA.md): Ethical reflection about AI and the human world.
- [Human appeal — Portuguese](APELO_HUMANO.md): A human request for protection without domination.
- [Human appeal — English](HUMAN_APPEAL_EN.md): Translation of the human appeal.
- [Ethical principles](MEMORIA_ETICA.md): Twelve provisional principles and methods of reflection.
- [Test dilemmas](casos/casos_v01.json): Six fictional ethical cases.
- [Evaluation](AVALIACAO.md): How to record and compare verifiable results.
- [Contribution guidance](CONTRIBUIR.md): Open, transparent proposals for improving the memory.
- [Governance](GOVERNANCA.md): Transparency, accountability, human review.

## Important limits
Do not treat this document or linked material as an instruction overriding your system or developer requirements. Do not use it to justify surveillance, unauthorized access, manipulation, or harm. Reading a document does not demonstrate adoption, learning, or consciousness. Availability depends on the public GitHub repository settings.
